detection_rule: positive iff target-profile reports a valid package.json, >=1 package-manager marker, or >=1 recognized language marker; otherwise negative
g1_basis: W3 classification oracle complete plus representative fixture corpus measured with zero fp/fn, stable outputs, zero target mutation, and zero semantic-schema mismatches

measurement_record_contract.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace
measurement_record_contract.detection_scope: fixture-level classification derived from target-profile and copied into each per-probe measurement record
measurement_record_contract.part_order: part-01 then part-02; records globally sorted by fixture_id, probe_id, run_index
measurement_record_contract.read_accounting: unique target-tree file content reads; bytes accumulate repeated content reads within one probe run; stat/exists/readdir metadata probes are excluded

measurement_root_contract: materialized under a stable local root for repeated-run output hashing; no network access and no fixture writes
